details.label: Summary
details.text: Isolated occurrences of locally damaging winds appear possible with the strongest storms this afternoon. The areal coverage of the threat is expected to remain too limited to warrant a watch issuance

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Visible satellite and radar imagery indicate a gradual increase in thunderstorm activity early this afternoon from the Cumberland Plateau into the Blue Ridge, including the Great Smoky Mountains. In the absence of appreciable forcing for ascent, it appears daytime heating of a moist and moderately to strongly unstable air mass (MLCAPE of 1500-3000 J/kg - per latest objective analysis) is contributing to this development. Regional VWPs indicate rather weak vertical shear, which should limit the degree of storm organization with pulse-type storm modes expected. Nonetheless, isolated occurrences of locally damaging winds appear possible with the strongest storms, owing to the potential for effective water loading of convective downdrafts

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...UP TO 60 MPH

details.label: Summary
details.text: Isolated occurrences of locally damaging wind gusts appear possible this afternoon. The areal coverage of the threat is expected to remain too limited to warrant a watch issuance

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Recent trends in visible satellite imagery indicate a deepening cumulus field and incipient thunderstorm development along and ahead of a weak front settling south through southeast NC and northern SC. Modification of the 12Z CHS sounding for current surface conditions yields a moderate to strongly unstable environment with MLCAPE of around 3000 J/kg. The air mass is quite moist with PW of around 2.4 inches, suggesting the likelihood for downdraft enhancement via water loading with an attendant risk for damaging wind gusts. Vertical shear is quite weak, which will limit the degree of storm organization and longevity, likely resulting in an isolated areal coverage of the severe risk

details.label: Most probable threats
